title: Establish WF-05 Premium Motion Editing permanent style and cross-platform knowledge
goal: Promote actual V5/V6 work into a comprehensive reusable WF-05 style, adopting V5 clean typography and accepted V6 motion improvements while rejecting V6 bottom caption pills. Preserve tools, code, evidence, lessons, creative/metaphor DNA, technical QA, source recovery, and new-chat startup contracts. Register in the repository, publish to GitHub, populate the existing WF-05 Drive folder, and sync the project knowledge/status hubs accurately.
acceptance_criteria: Dedicated permanent WF-05 style and both registries; other workflows preserved
Latest user feedback encoded: no V6 lower caption pills by default; accepted V5/V6 facets clearly separated
Detailed source-backed knowledge, creative grammar, workflows, mistakes/causes/fixes, code/assets/evidence and coverage audit
Executable reusable templates/presets and fresh-chat instructions with tests; no frozen Einstein content substituted for new topics
Existing Drive WF-05 folder organized and verified; GitHub publication and configured cross-platform receipts contain real IDs
No unsupported completeness/3D/word-sync claims; no large or sensitive raw media in Git
